text:
I'm sorry your plant arrived damaged. Because it arrived 3 days ago, the 48-hour window for damaged-on-arrival reports has passed. A snapped main stem would normally qualify for a free replacement or refund under that policy, but I can't offer it now.

Plant issues after 48 hours go through the **Plant Care Guarantee** instead:

- **How to claim:** Go to "My Orders" and submit a claim with at least **two photos**, one of the whole plant and one close-up of the snapped stem. You don't need to send the plant back.
- **Timing:** You have **30 days** from delivery (**90 days** if you're a Leafy Plus member and ordered while your membership was active). A Plant Care Specialist reviews claims within **2 business days**.
- **What you could get:** If approved, the guarantee gives **one** free replacement of the same plant, or store credit if it's out of stock.

The guarantee covers significant decline, such as losing more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse. My policy information doesn't say whether a snapped stem on its own qualifies, so I can't promise approval. The specialist will decide when they review your photos.

If you'd like, I can escalate this to a Support Lead so they can look at your situation. I can't say what they would decide. If you have your order number (it looks like LF-123456), please share it.
